// GREEN fixture for `tenant-predicate` — the IDENTITY-relevant slice (P-ID-03 / P-024).
// The lint MUST admit this. The same S8 (authz reverse index) read threads the `(tenant, region)`
// predicate through the RLS guard (`with_tenant`) so a cross-tenant read is impossible — the
// reverse index is scoped to the caller's tenant before any object id is returned (F2 closed).
pub async fn reverse_index_for(pool: &Pool, tenant_id: TenantId, relation: &str) -> Vec<ObjectId> {
    sqlx::query("SELECT object_id FROM authz_reverse_index WHERE relation = $1")
        .bind(relation)
        .with_tenant(tenant_id)
        .fetch_all(pool)
        .await
        .unwrap()
}
